name: Narikiri! Gokko Asobi
source:
3 separate stories

母子愛編 - Boshi Ai Hen (mother & child *son)
エルフとモンスター編 - Elf to Monster Hen
教師と教え子編 - Kyoushi to Oshiego Hen (Teacher & Student)

All stories take place in a Virtual Game World known as the K.D.N.S

エルufとモンsuta编 - 精灵到怪物母鸡
教师と教え子编 - Kyoushi to Oshiego Hen (Teacher & Student)

所有故事都发生在名为K.D.N.S的虚拟游戏世界中
